projects.title: Phishing feature robustness
projects.description: Grouped robustness and raw-URL studies, plus a paired screenshot/URL benchmark on 7,050 provider-labelled examples.
projects.detail: Three seeds: URL ranking exceeded compact image and equal-fusion baselines. Collection and component-size limits remain.

projects.title: Citation-support checkpoints
projects.description: ALCE sentence-level transfer and independent RAGTruth evaluation on 900 answers from 150 question groups.
projects.detail: Source-only thresholds expose missed unsupported answers and high review burden. A manuscript draft is available; not peer reviewed.

projects.title: Early transient prioritisation
projects.description: RAPID-inspired GRU versus a frozen forest on matched three-day simulated PLAsTiCC observations.
projects.detail: One seed; both models missed the two independent targets at the 5% budget. No observed-event performance claim.
